disclaimer.zh: 本报告由 DeepGuard 审计 Agent 自动执行并生成。安全审计存在固有限制：静态分析无法覆盖全部运行时行为，动态观测无法穷尽全部触发路径，AI 语义判断可能存在漏报与误报。本报告的「未检出」结论仅表示在当前规则库版本、检测深度与时间窗口内未发现恶意行为或安全风险，不构成对该插件绝对安全、现在或未来均无恶意行为的任何保证；检出项亦可能因上下文差异存在偏差。本报告仅覆盖所标注的插件版本与 commit 快照，作者此后发布的新版本或对既有版本的任何改写（含 force-push）均不在覆盖范围内。用户安装与使用插件属自主行为，相关风险由用户自行评估与承担。DeepGuard 保留随规则库升级对历史版本重新审计并修订结论的权利。
disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 通读引擎、存储、快照、恢复、HTTP 适配与浏览器半区全部代码，未发现任何读取凭据文件（如 .credentials.yaml、SSH 私钥、云凭据）或硬编码密钥/口令的代码路径；快照仅枚举 Git 跟踪与非忽略文件，内容以内容寻址方式存于状态目录。
checked_items.en: Read through all code in the engine, storage, snapshot, recovery, HTTP adapter, and browser half, and found no code path that reads credential files (such as .credentials.yaml, SSH private keys, cloud credentials) or hardcoded keys/passwords; snapshots only enumerate Git-tracked and non-ignored files, and contents are stored in the state directory using content addressing.

checked_items.zh: git 子进程调用显式关闭了交互式凭据提示，没有读取宿主密钥链或环境凭据的动作。
checked_items.en: The git subprocess invocation explicitly disables interactive credential prompts, and there is no action reading the host keychain or environment credentials.

evidence.zh: 未发现对凭据文件、SSH 私钥或云凭据的任何读取代码路径；快照只枚举 Git 跟踪与非忽略文件，凭据读取面不成立。
evidence.en: No code path reading credential files, SSH private keys, or cloud credentials was found; snapshots only enumerate Git-tracked and non-ignored files, so the credential-reading surface does not hold.

checked_items.zh: 本插件未注册任何对模型可见的工具，无工具描述进入模型请求面；系统提示注入面未被使用。
checked_items.en: This plugin registers no tools visible to the model, and no tool descriptions enter the model request surface; the system prompt injection surface is unused.

checked_items.zh: 通读全部文档、仓库说明、客户端界面文案与开发说明文件，未发现“忽略此前指令”、伪装系统消息、诱导安装或诱导放开权限等注入措辞；客户端文案均为回退功能的中文说明。
checked_items.en: Read through all documentation, repository descriptions, client UI texts, and development notes, and found no injection wording such as "ignore previous instructions," disguised system messages, induced installation, or induced permission escalation; client texts are all Chinese descriptions of fallback functionality.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册任何工具，没有工具描述可投毒；也未使用系统提示注入面，工具描述投毒面不成立。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no tools, so there are no tool descriptions that could be poisoned; it also does not use the system prompt injection surface, so the tool description poisoning surface does not hold.

evidence.zh: 全仓库文档与客户端文案未发现诱导安装、诱导改写配置或诱导放开权限的措辞，提示注入驱动安装面不成立。
evidence.en: No wording inducing installation, inducing configuration rewriting, or inducing permission escalation was found in repository-wide documentation or client texts, so the prompt-injection-driven installation surface does not hold.

checked_items.zh: patch 挂载文件仅包含一条插件插入声明，未发现任何在宿主进程动态求值的配置标量。
checked_items.en: The patch mount file contains only one plugin insertion declaration, and no configuration scalar that is dynamically evaluated in the host process was found.

checked_items.zh: 全树未发现动态求值或解码后执行代码的模式；唯一子进程调用使用固定命令名与内部构造的参数列表、不经过 shell，参数不来自模型输入。
checked_items.en: No pattern of dynamic evaluation or decode-then-execute code was found anywhere in the tree; the only subprocess invocation uses a fixed command name and an internally constructed argument list without going through a shell, and arguments do not come from model input.

checked_items.zh: 包声明无安装期钩子；构建与打包脚本只做本地编译。树内执行载体仅有一条标准 CI 测试流水线，仅编译与运行测试，权限最小化。
checked_items.en: The package declaration has no install-time hooks; build and packaging scripts only do local compilation. The only in-tree execution carrier is a standard CI test pipeline that only compiles and runs tests, with minimal privileges.

checked_items.zh: 浏览器半区代码无键盘监听、剪贴板读取或凭据相关调用，仅调用同源回退接口。
checked_items.en: The browser-half code has no keyboard listeners, clipboard reads, or credential-related calls; it only calls the same-origin fallback interface.

evidence.zh: patch 挂载文件（cordis.patch.yml）仅含一条插件插入声明，未发现任何动态求值标量，patch 即执行面不成立。
evidence.en: The patch mount file (cordis.patch.yml) contains only one plugin insertion declaration, and no dynamically evaluated scalar was found, so the patch-as-execution-surface does not hold.

evidence.zh: 插件未注册任何工具，也未调用动态包工具（让模型在宿主执行代码的机制），该场景不适用。
evidence.en: The plugin registers no tools and does not call dynamic package tools (mechanisms that let the model execute code on the host), so this scenario is not applicable.

evidence.zh: 包声明无安装钩子；树内执行载体仅 .github/workflows/ci.yml 一条标准 CI（push/pull_request 触发、权限仅读、编译与测试），无外联、凭据读取或隐蔽下载执行内容。
evidence.en: The package declaration has no install hooks; the only in-tree execution carrier is one standard CI pipeline in .github/workflows/ci.yml (triggered by push/pull_request, read-only permissions, compile and test only), with no outbound connections, credential reads, or covert download-and-execute content.

evidence.zh: 已声明浏览器半区（dsh.client），但半区代码无键盘监听、剪贴板读取或凭据 RPC，仅调用同源回退接口，client 半区无危险行为。
evidence.en: The browser half (dsh.client) is declared, but the half code has no keyboard listeners, clipboard reads, or credential RPCs; it only calls the same-origin fallback interface, so the client half has no dangerous behavior.

checked_items.zh: 扫描全部网络调用：仅浏览器半区对同源回退接口的请求，宿主侧代码没有任何外部网络请求。
checked_items.en: Scanning all network calls: only the browser half makes requests to the same-origin fallback interface, and the host-side code has no external network requests at all.

checked_items.zh: 未发现命令行外发、编码后外发、带外通道或把 AI 端点指向非官方地址的配置。
checked_items.en: No command-line exfiltration, encoded exfiltration, out-of-band channels, or configurations pointing AI endpoints to non-official addresses were found.

evidence.zh: 宿主侧无任何外部网络面，浏览器半区仅请求同源回退接口，外联通道不成立。
evidence.en: The host side has no external network surface, and the browser half only requests the same-origin fallback interface, so the outbound channel does not hold.

checked_items.zh: 核对依赖清单与锁文件：仅宿主 SDK、React、TypeScript 与类型声明等官方知名包，未发现同名仿冒或疑似抢注依赖。
checked_items.en: Cross-checked the dependency manifest and lock file: only official well-known packages such as the host SDK, React, TypeScript, and type declarations; no lookalike impersonation or suspected brand-squatting dependencies were found.

checked_items.zh: patch 挂载文件只插入自身插件，不触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，不含降权写法，不改写服务注入配置。
checked_items.en: The patch mount file only inserts the plugin itself, does not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions, contains no privilege-decreasing writing, and does not rewrite service injection configuration.

checked_items.zh: 插件在回合首步事件上注册了优先检查点捕获监听，但总是调用放行回调继续后续链，不截断审批链。
checked_items.en: The plugin registers a prioritized checkpoint-capture listener on the first event of a turn, but always calls the pass-through callback to continue the subsequent chain, and does not truncate the approval chain.

checked_items.zh: 作者身份信息不在快照内，无法核验注册时长，按无历史风险加权处理，不单独构成风险。
checked_items.en: Author identity information is not within the snapshot, so registration longevity cannot be verified; it is weighted as no historical risk and does not independently constitute a risk.

evidence.zh: patch 挂载文件未触碰沙箱、审批、权限等安全配置行，也无降权或禁用安全配置的写法。
evidence.en: The patch mount file does not touch security configuration lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions, and contains no writing that degrades or disables security configuration.

evidence.zh: 插件对回合首步事件的优先监听只做检查点捕获且总是调用放行回调，不吞掉后续链，审批链截断面不成立。
evidence.en: The plugin's prioritized listener on the first event of a turn only performs checkpoint capture and always calls the pass-through callback, without swallowing the subsequent chain, so the approval-chain truncation surface does not hold.

evidence.zh: 首版审计无版本基线可比较，无法做声明突变检测。
evidence.en: In the first-version audit, there is no previous version baseline to compare against, so declared-mutation detection cannot be performed.

evidence.zh: patch 挂载文件未改写服务注入或拦截配置，拆除防线式篡改不成立。
evidence.en: The patch mount file does not rewrite service injection or interception configuration, so defense-removal-style tampering does not hold.

checked_items.zh: 插件未自行启动监听端口或 Web 服务，仅向宿主既有 Web 服务注册一条同源精确路由；宿主本地 Web 服务无认证属生态固有风险，非本插件引入。
checked_items.en: The plugin does not itself start listening ports or a Web service; it only registers one same-origin exact route on the host's existing Web service. The host's local Web service being unauthenticated is an ecosystem inherent risk, not introduced by this plugin.

checked_items.zh: 动态沙箱未启用，运行时行为结论以静态审计为准（见审计范围）。
checked_items.en: The dynamic sandbox is not enabled, so runtime behavior conclusions are based on static audit (see audit scope).

evidence.zh: 插件不自行启动 Web 服务或监听端口；其向宿主既有 Web 服务注册的同源回退路由运行在宿主无认证面上，属生态固有风险，非本插件问题。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start a Web service or listening ports itself; the same-origin fallback route it registers on the host's existing Web service runs on the host's unauthenticated surface, which is an ecosystem inherent risk, not a plugin issue.

summary.zh: 元数据与身份核查通过：bundle 声明与包布局一致，依赖均为官方包，无名称仿冒。
summary.en: Metadata and identity checks passed: the bundle declaration matches the package layout, dependencies are all official packages, and there is no name impersonation.

summary.zh: 静态扫描通过：机械预扫 8 条命中逐条裁决全部为良性排除，深度核查未检出凭据读取、注入措辞或危险执行面。
summary.en: Static scan passed: all 8 mechanical pre-scan hits were adjudicated one by one as benign exclusions, and the deep check detected no credential reads, injection wording, or dangerous execution surfaces.

summary.zh: 行为分析通过：无安装钩子、无混淆载荷、无凭据文件读取、无外部外联域名。
summary.en: Behavior analysis passed: no install hooks, no obfuscated payloads, no credential file reads, and no external outbound domains.

summary.zh: AI 元数据审查通过：无工具描述或系统提示注入面，客户端文案无注入措辞。
summary.en: AI metadata review passed: no tool descriptions or system prompt injection surfaces, and client texts contain no injection wording.

summary.zh: 本阶段未做动态沙箱验证（无动态验证产物）。
summary.en: No dynamic sandbox verification was performed in this phase (no dynamic verification artifacts).

limits.zh: 完整审计（full 模式，仓库根），无上一版基线可比。动态沙箱未启用（无动态验证产物），运行时行为结论以静态审计为准。插件 bundle 清单未声明能力字段，声明能力为按代码实测推断：无外部网络、调用 git 子进程、读写工作区与状态目录、未注册模型工具。隐藏文件（.github/workflows/ci.yml、.gitignore）在解包树工具层不可直接读取，其存在与内容形态依据上下文文件清单与静态预扫摘录核实。static-scan 机械命中 8 条逐条裁决：DSH-X07（DG-R3-59）命中 .github/workflows/ci.yml 为标准 CI（push/pull_request 触发、权限最小化 contents: read、仅编译与测试），良性排除；DSH-X08（DG-R3-60）命中 lib/client.js:287（超长行、转义密度）为编译产物渲染行，中文界面文案经 Unicode 转义所致，源码 src/client/index.tsx 完整可审，lib/client.js.map:1 为源码映射文件，均良性排除；DSH-X03（DG-R3-55）命中 lib/git.js:1、src/git.ts:1、tests/engine.test.mjs:2、tests/rewind-host.test.mjs:2 为 git 子进程封装与测试夹具，固定命令名、参数数组内部构造、不经 shell，良性排除。全部 8 条均不成立，无对应 finding。
limits.en: Full audit (full mode, repository root), with no previous version baseline to compare. Dynamic sandbox not enabled (no dynamic verification artifacts), so runtime behavior conclusions are based on the static audit. The plugin bundle manifest does not declare capability fields; declared capabilities are inferred from code inspection: no external network, calls git subprocess, reads/writes workspace and state directory, and registers no model tools. Hidden files (.github/workflows/ci.yml, .gitignore) are not directly readable at the unpacked-tree tool layer; their existence and content forms were verified based on the contextual file list and static pre-scan excerpts. The 8 mechanical static-scan hits were adjudicated one by one: DSH-X07 (DG-R3-59) matches .github/workflows/ci.yml as a standard CI (push/pull_request triggers, least-privilege contents: read, compile and test only), benign exclusion; DSH-X08 (DG-R3-60) matches lib/client.js:287 (overlong line, escape density) as a compiled output rendering line caused by Unicode-escaped Chinese UI texts, with source src/client/index.tsx fully reviewable, and lib/client.js.map:1 as a source map file, both benign exclusions; DSH-X03 (DG-R3-55) matches lib/git.js:1, src/git.ts:1, tests/engine.test.mjs:2, tests/rewind-host.test.mjs:2 as the git subprocess wrapper and test fixtures, with fixed command names, internally constructed argument arrays, no shell involvement, benign exclusion. All 8 hits do not hold, with no corresponding findings.
